Name: JP's Animals Go Outside in Winter and Rain
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][b][i][color=#00ff00][size=6][u]Animals in a Rainy Winter[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b][/font][/center]


[b][i][font=Georgia][color=#00ffff][size=5]Because it's cheaper to get used to the cold than to buy a heater... Or so I think.[/size][/color][/font][/i][/b]

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][font=Georgia]Animals can go out on rainy and winter days and enjoy nature at its finest. [/font][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][font=Georgia]They will be able to carry out their normal activities such as eating grass and... eating grass... Oh, and also eating grass.[/font][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][font=Georgia]Naturally, it also allows pigs to go out and search for truffles in these climates, so it will be an extra benefit for your pocket. [/font][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][font=Georgia]You can also configure the mod to only allow animals from the Barn and/or Coop to go outside in winter and/or rain. You can also configure whether pigs will be able to search for truffles in these weather conditions. [/font][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]If you use [color=#00ff00]“The Good Pig”[/color] mod, which improves pig behavior, you can also benefit from specific loot in rain and snow. [/size]
[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[youtube]4KWOOFgC_zk[/youtube]

[size=5][i][i][color=#00ff00][size=5][b]That's it, GMCM is very necessary in this mod in order to configure the mod according to your preferences. You will find detailed information in each option. [/b][/size][/color][/i][/i]

[b][i][i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[/i][/b][size=4][b][i]You are free to translate the mod;[color=#ff0000] you don't need to ask my permission[/color][color=#ff0000].[/color]
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/i][/b]

[/size][/size][/font]
